boundaries: Only direct public YouTube video and Short URLs are accepted.

With an explicit language, an exact language code is preferred before a broader family match; manual beats automatic for the same exact language. With language=auto, English then Dutch then another language is selected, with manual before automatic within a language.
If no caption track exists, the request succeeds with status skipped_no_captions and no transcript file.
The acquisition job runs only on a dedicated self-hosted Linux x64 runner or through scripts/run_local.sh on a normal direct network connection.
No comments, channel or playlist discovery, search, ranking, topic filtering, engagement data, knowledge handoff, article/feed/sitemap extraction, audio fallback or Whisper exists in this runtime.
No cookies, login, proxy, CAPTCHA bypass, PO token or media download is used.
Deno is passed explicitly to yt-dlp through --js-runtimes; it is not a dead prerequisite.
Only minimal caption provenance is persisted; raw yt-dlp metadata is not persisted.
Project identity, live source-set versions, project routing and project policy are supplied and owned outside this repository.
